c74object.name: evi_squine_simple
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A basic implementation of Rasmus Ekman's 'squine wave' oscillator with audio rate modulation
c74object.description:
evi_squine_simple is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_squine_simple is also available in MSP as: evi.squine.simple~.
An extremely versatile phase modulation oscillator which can morph shape and does not alias (up to a certain point). Inlets are available for linear and logarithmic FM modulation, as well as optionally audio rate control over the shape morphing.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ freq, pitch, freq, harmonics, duty } }

geninlet.name: freq
geninlet.digest: in Hz or Pitch. Oscillator frequency in Hz or Pitch depending on @freqmode attribute.

geninlet.name: pitch
geninlet.digest: Mod @default 0.. FM the oscillator frequency, in Pitch units.

geninlet.name: freq
geninlet.digest: (Hz) Mod @default 0.. FM the oscillator frequency, in Hz units.

geninlet.name: harmonics
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @default 0.5. One of two main wave shaping controls along with inlet 5. Harmonics normalised 0..1. At 0, no harmonics are added and the output is sine-wave-like (if inlet 5 'duty cycle' is set at it's default 0.5). Increasing this value gradually adds harmonics to the waveform as it morphs from sine-like to square-wave-like.

geninlet.name: duty
geninlet.digest: Cycle 0..1 @default 0.5. One of two main wave shaping controls along with inlet 4. PWM normalised 0..1. Shifts the waveform from negative to positive saw-wave-like through the shape created by inlet 4 ('harmonics').

attribute.name: freqmode
attribute.description: Switch oscillator frequency (inlet 1) units between input in Pitch (on, default) or input in Hz (off).

attribute.name: freqmul
attribute.description: Multiplier of samplerate to set maximum frequency input. Typically this would be lower than samplerate/4 (0.25).

attribute.name: freqsmooth
attribute.description: Smooth frequency input (inlet 1) by this amount in ms. Note that it is safe to smooth this evern if audio rate modulating using inlets 2 and 3 as summing is post smooth.
